decision: Treat #4388 as residue of #4038 / slizard#2826, not a new detector class

governingRule.description: Bound-remedy 5650036741: record what #4038 completion delivered; bind compile-with-compilerOptions only; drop skip and basename allowlist; recut Evidence to a real tsc run.

alternativesConsidered.option: Treat #4388 as a new honour-the-tsconfig class
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: The same config-read class was already recorded on #4038 and shipped partial on slizard#2826. A second completed record would close the same way.
exclude-all is a PR-author-controlled gate-disable. TS18003 or empty fileNames on a tsconfig-touching PR must be a finding.

alternativesConsidered.option: Special-case JSONC by closed basename allowlist
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: tsconfig.build.json, tsconfig.node.json, and other comment-bearing configs miss the list and grow a new false-positive class.

whyWinner: slizard#2826 shipped libProvidesConsole for TS2584 console plus JSX key/ref and active-brief skip. json-syntax still JSON.parse's tsconfig.json. typescript-compilation-check already reads compilerOptions via ts.readConfigFile but ignores parsed.errors and empty fileNames and still compiles changed .ts as rootNames. Residue is extend that config read: compilerOptions only, no skip, compiler API for tsconfig/jsconfig, recut Evidence to tsc 5.9.3 TS2307 plus TS5097 at line 8.
revisitTrigger: If slizard json-syntax routes tsconfig/jsconfig through ts.readConfigFile plus parseJsonConfigFileContent, and typescript-compilation reports TS18003 or empty fileNames when the PR touches tsconfig.json.
